items.text: In six primary care practices over four months, is a laboratory hold rule for HbA1c requests within 80 days of the previous result feasible, judged by override timeliness, safety of held requests, firing rate and requester acceptability against pre-specified progression criteria?
items.population: HbA1c requests from six pilot practices, January to April 2027
items.intervention: Hold rule with explanatory comment and override
items.outcome: Overrides for accepted exceptions completed within one working day
items.setting: Regional laboratory and six primary care practices

finer: Feasible within staff time and the laboratory information system; interesting to the laboratory and network; novel locally; ethical with a safety review and override; relevant to the reagent contract decision.
summary: One feasibility question with progression thresholds.
